review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for the other declarations of the same concepts. The `→L⋆[`/`≃L⋆[` notations appear only here, and other files (for example InnerProductSpace/LinearMap.lean and Adjoint.lean) use them. `starL` and `starL'` are the continuous upgrades of `starLinearEquiv` in Algebra/Star/Module.lean, with `toLinearEquiv := starLinearEquiv R`. `starₗᵢ` is the isometric version, and Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Basic.lean relates the two by a lemma, so it is not a competing definition. `selfAdjointPartL`, `skewAdjointPartL` and `StarModule.decomposeProdAdjointL` wrap the existing linear maps `selfAdjointPart`, `skewAdjointPart` and `decomposeProdAdjoint` with continuity proofs. They are named continuous upgrades of those linear maps, not independent re-implementations. I found no competing definition of any of these concepts, so I report nothing. I did not check Mathlib for other places that define the continuous star-linear structures, beyond the greps above.
